name: Physical Rate Translation
description: Converts the duration-based scheduling problem into a volume-based dispensing problem. The time limit T is preserved, but durations p1 and p2 are presented as required volumes of two reagents. A fixed dispensing rate of 1 unit/second bridges the gap. This removes standard scheduling keywords (duration, deadline, machine, job, processing time) while keeping the arithmetic conditions logically identical and rigorously defined.
